meaning:
δειλός, -ή, όν
(δέος), [in LXX for רַךְ, etc. ;]
cowardly, fearful: Mat.8:26, Mrk.4:40, Rev.21:8.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.
He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns…
